disclaimer: Research tool, not financial advice. Scores and findings describe public filings; they are not recommendations to buy, sell or hold any security. Qualitative findings are produced by a language model, checked by code and a second model pass, and can be wrong.
attribution: Filings and XBRL data: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR (public domain)
caveats: Valuation criteria (G6, G7) pending price data.

method.score: lower bound of the 95% Wilson score interval for met / decided (z = 1.96), to 3 decimals; percent_met is the plain share
method.met: criteria with the label pass or partial_pass
method.decided: criteria with the label pass, partial_pass or fail, over G1 to G7 and B1 to B4; not_applicable, not_meaningful and data_gap are left out
method.pending: G6 and G7 wait for licensed price data: they are shown as pending, are not data gaps and are not counted as decided
method.minimum_decided: the main ranking needs at least 7 decided criteria; banks and insurers (fewer tests apply) are ranked in their own section from 4; the others are listed as insufficient data with their counts
method.ties: higher met, then fewer data gaps, then symbol
